en.t: Roman emperor Elagabalus is murdered alongside his mother, Julia Soaemias. He is replaced by his 14-year old cousin, Severus Alexander
en.s: Julia Soaemias Bassiana (180 – 11 March 222) was a Syrian noblewoman and the mother of Roman emperor Elagabalus, who ruled over the Roman Empire from 218 to 222. She was one of his chief advisors, initially with the support and accompaniment of her mother Julia Maesa. She and her mother guided the young emperor until growing unrest and a family division led to her son's replacement by her nephew Severus Alexander.

zh.t: 罗马皇帝埃拉伽巴路斯与母亲朱莉娅·索艾米亚斯一同遇害，14岁的表弟塞维鲁·亚历山大继位
zh.s: 朱莉娅·索艾米亚斯·巴西安娜（180年—222年3月11日）是叙利亚贵族，也是罗马皇帝埃拉伽巴路斯的母亲；埃拉伽巴路斯于218年至222年统治罗马帝国。她是儿子的重要顾问之一，起初有母亲朱莉娅·梅萨陪同并支持。她和母亲辅佐这位年轻皇帝，直到日益加剧的动荡和家族分裂导致儿子被她的外甥塞维鲁·亚历山大取代。

en.t: Election of Pope Felix III following the death of Pope Simplicius earlier that month
en.s: Pope Felix III (died 1 March 492) was the bishop of Rome from 13 March 483 to his death on 1 March 492. His repudiation of the Henotikon is considered the beginning of the Acacian schism. He is commemorated on 1 March.

zh.t: 教宗菲利克斯三世当选
zh.s: 教宗辛普利修斯于当月早些时候去世后，菲利克斯三世当选继任。菲利克斯三世（492年3月1日去世）于483年3月13日至492年3月1日担任罗马主教。他否定《亨诺提孔》被视为阿卡西亚分裂的开端。纪念日为3月1日。

en.s: The Battle of Badr (Arabic: غزوة بدر‎‎), fought on Tuesday, 13 March 624 CE (17 Ramadan, 2 AH in the Islamic calendar) in the Hejaz region of western Arabia (present-day Saudi Arabia), was supposedly a key battle in the early days of Islam and a turning point in Muhammad's struggle with his opponents among the Quraish in Mecca. The battle has been passed down in Islamic history as a decisive victory attributable to divine intervention, or by secular sources to the strategic genius of Muhammad. It is one of the few battles specifically mentioned in the Quran.

zh.s: 白德尔战役于公元624年3月13日星期二（伊斯兰历2年斋月17日）在阿拉伯半岛西部汉志地区、今沙特阿拉伯境内发生，通常被认为是伊斯兰教早期的一场关键战役，也是穆罕默德与麦加古莱什部落对手斗争的转折点。在伊斯兰历史记述中，这场决定性胜利归功于神的介入；世俗记述则将其归功于穆罕默德的战略才干。这也是《古兰经》中明确提及的少数战役之一。

en.s: The Treaty of Nymphaeum was a trade and defense pact signed between the Empire of Nicaea and the Republic of Genoa in Nymphaion in March 1261. This treaty would have a major impact on both the restored Byzantine Empire and the Republic of Genoa that would later dictate their histories for several centuries to come.

zh.s: 尼姆法翁条约是尼西亚帝国与热那亚共和国于1261年3月在尼姆法翁签署的贸易和防御协定。该条约对复辟后的拜占庭帝国和热那亚共和国影响深远，也在此后数百年间左右了两国的历史。

en.t: Siege of Warangal: Sultan Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq sends an expeditionary army led by his son, Muhammad bin Tughluq, to the Kakatiya capital Warangal – after ruler Prataparudra has refused to make tribute payments. He besieges the city and finally, after a campaign of 8 months, Prataparudra surrenders on November 9
en.s: Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq Shah (Persian: غیاث الدین تغلق شاہ), also known as Ghazi Malik (غازی ملک; died 1 February 1325), was the Sultan of Delhi from 1320 to 1325. He was the first sultan of the Tughluq dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate. During his reign, Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq founded the city of Tughluqabad. His reign ended upon his death in 1325 when a pavilion built in his honour collapsed.

zh.t: 图格鲁克派军围攻瓦朗加尔
zh.s: 1323年3月13日，德里苏丹吉亚斯丁·图格鲁克派儿子穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克率远征军前往卡卡提亚首都瓦朗加尔。卡卡提亚国王普拉塔帕鲁德拉拒绝纳贡后，军队围城；经过8个月的战事，他于11月9日投降。

en.s: Samogitian uprisings refer to two uprisings by the Samogitians against the Teutonic Knights in 1401–1404 and 1409. Samogitia was granted to the Teutonic Knights by Vytautas the Great, Grand Duke of Lithuania, several times in order to enlist Knights' support for his other military affairs. The local population resisted Teutonic rule and asked Vytautas to protect them.

en.s: The Battle of Oosterweel took place on 13 March 1567 and is traditionally seen as the beginning of the Eighty Years' War. The battle was fought near the village of Oosterweel, north of Antwerp. A Spanish professional army under General Beauvoir defeated an army of radical Calvinists rebels under Jan de Marnix. The prisoners were considered rebels and all were killed. Some 700-800 Protestants died.William the Silent, the Burggraaf of Antwerp, did not allow the Protestants of the city to come to their aid, because he was, as lord of the city, bound by oath to support the Spanish King.

zh.s: 奥斯特韦尔战役于1567年3月13日在安特卫普以北的奥斯特韦尔村附近发生，传统上被视为八十年战争的开端。博瓦将军率领的西班牙职业军队，击败了扬·德·马尔尼克斯指挥的激进加尔文派叛军。俘虏被认定为叛乱者，全部遭杀害，约700至800名新教徒死亡。安特卫普城堡伯爵‘沉默者’威廉未允许城内新教徒前去救援，因为他作为城市领主，曾宣誓支持西班牙国王。

en.s: The Battle of Jarnac on 13 March 1569 was an encounter during the French Wars of Religion between the Catholic forces of Marshal Gaspard de Saulx, sieur de Tavannes, and the Huguenots, near the nadir of their fortunes, financed by Reinhold von Krockow (who was wounded in the battle) and led by Louis I de Bourbon, prince de Condé, who was killed after his surrender and his body paraded on an ass in Jarnac, to Catholic jeers. The forces met outside Jarnac between the right bank of the Charente River and the high road between Angoulême and Cognac.

zh.s: 雅纳克战役于1569年3月13日法国宗教战争期间发生，交战双方为塔瓦讷领主加斯帕尔·德·索元帅的天主教军队，以及当时处境已接近低谷的胡格诺派军队。胡格诺派由莱因霍尔德·冯·克罗科夫资助，他在战斗中受伤；军队由孔代亲王路易一世·德·波旁指挥。孔代投降后遭杀害，尸体被放在驴背上游街，遭到雅纳克天主教徒嘲弄。双方在雅纳克城外、夏朗德河右岸与昂古莱姆至干邑的大道之间交战。

en.s: The siege of Reval (1577) was a failed siege conducted by Tsar Ivan IV against the Swedish city of Reval during the Livonian War. Despite being able to occupy eastern Livonia, the Russian campaign eventually ended in failure due to the Russians failing to capture Reval.

en.s: The Battle of Tondibi was the decisive confrontation in the 16th-century invasion of the Songhai Empire by the army of the Saadi dynasty in Morocco. The Moroccan forces under Judar Pasha defeated the Songhai under Askia Ishaq II, guaranteeing the empire's downfall.

zh.s: 通迪比之战是16世纪摩洛哥萨阿德王朝军队入侵桑海帝国期间的决定性战役。朱达尔帕夏率领的摩洛哥军队击败阿斯基亚·伊沙克二世统率的桑海军队，导致桑海帝国覆亡。

en.s: The Fourth Spanish Armada, also known as the Last Armada, was a military expedition sent to Ireland that took place between August 1601 and March 1602 towards the end of Anglo-Spanish war. The armada – the fourth and smallest of its type, was sent on orders from the Spanish king Philip III to southwestern Ireland to assist the Irish rebels led by Hugh O'Neill, Earl of Tyrone, who were fighting to rid Ireland of Queen Elizabeth I of England's rule.

zh.s: 西班牙第四舰队远征又称最后一次舰队远征，是一支于1601年8月至1602年3月派往爱尔兰的军事远征队，发生在英西战争末期。西班牙国王腓力三世下令派出这支规模最小的西班牙舰队前往爱尔兰西南部，支援休·奥尼尔、蒂龙伯爵领导的爱尔兰叛军，后者正试图摆脱英格兰女王伊丽莎白一世的统治。

en.s: The Siege of the Portuguese fort Santa Cruz de Gale at Galle in 1640, took place during the Dutch–Portuguese and Sinhalese–Portuguese Wars. The Galle fort commanded 282 villages, which contained the most fertile cinnamon lands in southern Sri Lanka It was also an important strategic coastal defense of Portuguese Ceylon.

zh.s: 1640年，荷兰—葡萄牙战争和僧伽罗—葡萄牙战争期间，荷兰军队围攻葡萄牙在加勒修建的圣克鲁斯要塞。加勒要塞控制着282个村庄，这些村庄拥有斯里兰卡南部最肥沃的肉桂产地。要塞也是葡属锡兰重要的海岸防御据点。

en.s: The First Battle of Middlewich took place on 13 March 1643, during the First English Civil War, and was fought between the Parliamentarians, under Sir William Brereton, and the Royalist supporters of King Charles I of England, under Sir Thomas Aston.

zh.s: 第一次米德尔维奇之战于1643年3月13日在第一次英国内战期间爆发。议会派由威廉·布雷顿爵士率领，王党派则支持英格兰国王查理一世，由托马斯·阿斯顿爵士指挥。

en.s: The action of 12 March 1672 was a naval battle of the Third Anglo-Dutch War between a squadron commanded by Sir Robert Holmes and Sir Frescheville Holles against the Smyrna convoy, which was protected by 5 warships under De Haaze and Cornelis Evertsen. The Battle took place before the official start of the conflict, but now there was no turning back and England declared war on the Dutch Republic on March 17, 1672.

zh.s: 1672年3月12日海战是第三次英荷战争期间的一场海战。罗伯特·霍姆斯爵士和弗雷谢维尔·霍利斯爵士指挥的舰队袭击由德·哈泽和科内利斯·埃弗森率领、五艘军舰护航的士麦那船队。战斗发生时战争尚未正式开始，但局势已无法挽回；英国于1672年3月17日向荷兰共和国宣战。

en.s: The siege of Mombasa was an attack on the Portuguese city of Mombasa and Fort Jesus by the army of the Ya'rubid ruler of Oman, Saif I bin Sultan, from 13 March 1696 to 13 December 1698.

en.s: The Battle of Cartagena de Indias (Spanish: Sitio de Cartagena de Indias, lit. 'Siege of Cartagena de Indias') took place during the 1739 to 1748 War of Jenkins' Ear between Spain and Great Britain. The result of long-standing commercial tensions, the war was primarily fought in the Caribbean; the British tried to capture key Spanish ports in the region, including Porto Bello and Chagres in Panama, Havana, and Cartagena de Indias in present-day Colombia.
en.n: The Battle of Cartagena de Indias (part of the War of Jenkins' Ear) begins.

zh.t: 卡塔赫纳德印第亚斯之战
zh.s: 卡塔赫纳德印第亚斯之战（西班牙语：Sitio de Cartagena de Indias，意为“卡塔赫纳德印第亚斯围城战”）发生于1739至1748年的詹金斯耳朵战争期间，交战双方是西班牙和英国。战争由长期贸易摩擦引发，主要战场在加勒比海。英国试图攻占该地区的重要西班牙港口，包括巴拿马的波托韦洛和查格雷斯、哈瓦那，以及今属哥伦比亚的卡塔赫纳德印第亚斯。
zh.n: 詹金斯耳朵战争期间，卡塔赫纳德印第亚斯之战开始。

en.s: The Battle on Snowshoes was fought on March 13, 1758, during the French and Indian War. It was fought by a British force led by Captain Robert Rogers against French troops and Indians allied to France. The battle took place near Lake George, now in northern New York, but then in the frontier area between the British Province of New York and the French province of Canada.

zh.s: 雪鞋之战于1758年3月13日在法国与印第安人战争期间爆发。英国军队由罗伯特·罗杰斯上尉率领，对阵法国军队及其印第安盟军。战斗发生在乔治湖附近；该地区现属纽约州北部，当时则位于英国纽约省与法国加拿大省之间的边疆地带。

en.s: Frederick William Herschel ( HUR-shəl; German: Friedrich Wilhelm Herschel [ˈfʁiːdʁɪç ˈvɪlhɛlm ˈhɛʁʃl̩]; 15 November 1738 – 25 August 1822) was a German–British astronomer and composer. He frequently collaborated with his younger sister and fellow astronomer Caroline Herschel. Born in the Electorate of Hanover, he followed his father into the military band of Hanover, before emigrating to Britain in 1757 at the age of 19.

en.t: William Herschel first observed Uranus on 13 March 1781, leading to its discovery as a planet, expanding the known boundaries of the Solar System for the first time in history and making Uranus the first planet classified as such with the aid of a telescope
en.s: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun. It is a gaseous cyan-coloured ice giant. Most of the planet is made of water, ammonia, and methane in a supercritical phase of matter, which astronomers call "ice" or "volatiles". The planet's atmosphere has a complex layered cloud structure, and has the lowest minimum temperature (49 K (−224 °C; −371 °F)) of all of the Solar System's planets.

Incumbent Federalist President John Sullivan defeated Anti-Federalist candidate and former President John Langdon, 1785 President Anti-Federalist candidate Josiah Bartlett and Federalist judge Samuel Livermore.

en.s: The Battle of Mandora was a minor battle fought on 13 March 1801 between French forces under François Lanusse and the British expeditionary corps under Ralph Abercromby, during the French invasion of Egypt and Syria. zh.s: 曼多拉之战是一次小规模战斗，于1801年3月13日埃及和叙利亚法军入侵期间爆发。弗朗索瓦·拉努斯指挥的法军与拉尔夫·阿伯克龙比指挥的英国远征军交战。法军试图阻止英军向其控制的亚历山大港推进，但未能成功。

en.s: The action of 13 March 1806 was a naval engagement of the Napoleonic Wars, fought when a British and a French squadron met unexpectedly in the mid-Atlantic. Neither force was aware of the presence of the other prior to the encounter and were participating in separate campaigns.

en.s: The Congress of Vienna of 1814–1815 was a series of international diplomatic meetings to discuss and agree upon a possible new layout of the European political and constitutional order after the downfall of the French emperor Napoleon Bonaparte. zh.s: 第一次诺加莱斯战役于1913年3月13日在墨西哥索诺拉州边境城市诺加莱斯发生，是墨西哥革命期间联邦军与宪政派叛军的一场交战。阿尔瓦罗·奥夫雷贡将军率领叛军，进攻约400名联邦军步兵组成的驻军。奥夫雷贡的部队包括步兵、骑兵，以及至少一门火炮。

en.s: The Second Battle of Topolobampo was a bloodless naval engagement during the Mexican Revolution. In March 1914, a rebel Constitutionalist gunboat attempted to break the blockade of Topolobampo, Sinaloa in Mexico. The attack forced federal gunboats to a further distance but failed to lift the blockade.

zh.t: 拓波洛班波第二次海战
zh.s: 拓波洛班波第二次海战是墨西哥革命期间一场没有造成人员伤亡的海战。1914年3月，一艘支持宪政派的叛军炮艇试图突破墨西哥锡那罗亚州拓波洛班波的封锁。袭击迫使联邦炮艇后撤，但未能解除封锁。

en.s: The Battle of Neuve-Chapelle (10–13 March 1915) took place in the First World War in Artois in France. The attack was intended to cause a rupture in the German lines, which would then be exploited with a rush to the Aubers Ridge and possibly Lille. A French assault at Vimy Ridge on the Artois plateau was also planned to threaten the road, rail and canal junctions at La Bassée from the south as the British attacked from the north.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 讷夫沙佩勒战役于1915年3月10日至13日在第一次世界大战期间、法国阿图瓦地区进行。进攻意在突破德军防线，随后乘势推进至奥贝尔岭，甚至可能攻占里尔。英军从北面进攻时，法军也计划在阿图瓦高原的维米岭发动攻击，从南面威胁拉巴塞的公路、铁路和运河交汇处。

en.s: The Battle of Nambanje was a minor engagement between British and German colonial forces during the East African Campaign of World War I. It involved the 1st East African Division and took place on 13 March 1917. Several British units were ordered to attack German forces that had been spotted near Nambanje. The British advance was detected by the Germans the day before, which enabled them to prepare and repulse the attack.

zh.s: 南班杰之战是第一次世界大战东非战役期间英国与德国殖民军之间的一次小规模交战，发生于1917年3月13日，涉及东非第一师。英军接到命令，攻击在南班杰附近发现的德军。德军前一天已发现英军推进，因此得以做好准备并击退进攻。

en.s: Operations on the Ancre took place from 11 January to 13 March 1917, between the British Fifth Army and the German 1st Army, on the Somme front during the First World War. After the Battle of the Ancre (13–18 November 1916), British attacks on the Somme front stopped for the winter. Until early January 1917, both sides were reduced to surviving the rain, snow, fog, mud fields, waterlogged trenches and shell-holes.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 安克河战事于1917年1月11日至3月13日在第一次世界大战索姆河战线上进行，交战双方是英国第五集团军和德国第一集团军。1916年11月13日至18日的安克河战役结束后，英军暂停了索姆河战线上的进攻，转入冬季休整。直到1917年1月初，双方都只能设法熬过雨雪、大雾、泥地、积水战壕和炮弹坑。

en.s: Battle of Bakhmach (Bitva u Bachmače in Czech), was one of the last battles on the Eastern Front in World War I between the Entente-backed Czechoslovak Legion, Soviet Russia and the Central Powers occupying Ukraine after the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk. The battle lasted from March 8 to March 13, 1918, over the city of Bakhmach and was the last engagement in World War I for the Soviets.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 巴赫马奇战役（捷克语：Bitva u Bachmače）是第一次世界大战东线最后几场战斗之一。交战双方是协约国支持的捷克斯洛伐克军团、苏俄，以及《布列斯特-立陶夫斯克条约》后占领乌克兰的同盟国。战斗于1918年3月8日至13日在巴赫马奇城周围进行，也是苏俄在一战中的最后一次交战。

en.s: The Kapp Putsch (German pronunciation: [ˈkapˌpʊt͡ʃ] ), also known as the Kapp–Lüttwitz Putsch (German pronunciation: [kapˈlʏtvɪt͡sˌpʊt͡ʃ] ), was an abortive coup d'état against the German national government in Berlin on 13 March 1920. Named after its leaders Wolfgang Kapp and Walther von Lüttwitz, its goal was to undo the German Revolution of 1918–1919, overthrow the Weimar Republic, and establish an autocratic government.

zh.s: 卡普政变（德语发音：[ˈkapˌpʊt͡ʃ]），又称卡普—吕特维茨政变，是一次针对德国柏林中央政府的未遂政变，发生于1920年3月13日。政变以领导人沃尔夫冈·卡普和瓦尔特·冯·吕特维茨命名，旨在推翻魏玛共和国、终结1918—1919年德国革命，并建立独裁政府。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Germany on 13 March 1932, with a runoff on 10 April. Independent incumbent Paul von Hindenburg won a second seven-year term against Adolf Hitler of the Nazi Party (NSDAP). Communist Party (KPD) leader Ernst Thälmann also ran and received more than ten percent of the vote in the runoff.

zh.s: 德国于1932年3月13日举行总统选举，4月10日进行第二轮决选。无党派现任总统保罗·冯·兴登堡击败纳粹党的阿道夫·希特勒，赢得第二个七年任期。德国共产党领袖恩斯特·台尔曼也参加竞选，在第二轮获得超过10%的选票。

en.s: The Winter War was a war between the Soviet Union and Finland. It began with a Soviet invasion of Finland on 30 November 1939, three months after the outbreak of World War II, and ended three and a half months later with the Moscow Peace Treaty on 13 March 1940. Despite superior military strength, especially in tanks and aircraft, the Soviet Union suffered severe losses and initially made little headway.

zh.s: 冬季战争是苏联与芬兰之间的战争。1939年11月30日，苏联入侵芬兰，冬季战争由此开始；二战爆发三个月后，战争于1940年3月13日以《莫斯科和平条约》签署告终，历时三个半月。尽管苏联在军力上占据优势，尤其是坦克和飞机数量更多，但它伤亡惨重，初期进展甚微。

en.t: Swedish intervention in the Winter War
en.s: The Swedish Intervention in the Winter War was a short-lived but successful attempt by the Swedish Volunteer Corps, along with other Nordic volunteers, to prevent a Soviet invasion of Finland during the Winter War. The volunteers only engaged in a few skirmishes on ground and in the air, the only major battles they participated in being the battles of Salla and Honkaniemi.

zh.s: 冬季战争期间，瑞典志愿军团及其他北欧志愿者试图阻止苏联入侵芬兰。这场持续时间较短的行动取得成功。志愿者只参加了少数陆地和空中小规模交战，参加过的主要战役只有萨拉战役和洪卡涅米战役。

en.s: Operation Sportpalast (German: Sports Palace), also known as Unternehmen Nordmeer (German: Operation Northern Sea), was a German naval raid between 6 and 13 March 1942 in the Norwegian Sea against two Allied Arctic convoys during the Second World War. It was conducted by the battleship Tirpitz, three destroyers and eight submarines. The German ships were unable to locate either of the convoys but sank a merchant vessel that was sailing independently.

zh.s: “体育宫”行动（德语：Sports Palace）又称“北海行动”（德语：Unternehmen Nordmeer），是德国海军于1942年3月6日至13日在挪威海发动的突袭，目标是两支盟军北极船队。德军出动“提尔皮茨”号战列舰、三艘驱逐舰和八艘潜艇，但未能找到任何一支船队，只击沉一艘独自航行的商船。

en.s: The invasion of Salamaua–Lae (8–13 March 1942), called Operation SR by the Japanese, was an operation by Imperial Japanese forces to occupy the Salamaua–Lae area in the Territory of New Guinea during the Pacific campaign of World War II. The Japanese invaded and occupied the location in order to construct an airfield and establish a base to cover and support the advance of Japanese forces into the eastern New Guinea and Coral Sea areas.

zh.s: 萨拉毛阿—莱城入侵行动于1942年3月8日至13日进行，日方代号为SR行动，是二战太平洋战役期间日本帝国军队占领新几内亚领地萨拉毛阿—莱城地区的军事行动。日军占领该地区是为了修建机场和建立基地，以掩护并支援其向新几内亚东部和珊瑚海地区推进。

en.t: The Holocaust: German forces liquidate the Jewish ghetto in Kraków
en.s: The Holocaust, known in Hebrew as the Shoah, was the genocide of European Jews during World War II. From 1941 to 1945, Nazi Germany and its collaborators systematically murdered around six million Jews across German-occupied Europe, approximately two-thirds of Europe's Jewish population. The murders were committed primarily through mass shootings across Eastern Europe and poison gas chambers in extermination camps, chiefly Auschwitz-Birkenau, Treblinka, Belzec, Sobibor, Chełmno and Majdanek death camps in occupied Poland.

zh.t: 纳粹德国开始清空克拉科夫犹太人区
zh.s: 1943年3月13日至16日，纳粹党卫队和警察部队对克拉科夫犹太人区实施清剿。

en.s: A United Nations Secretary-General selection was held in 1953 after Trygve Lie announced his intention of resigning. Lie had been at odds with the Soviet Union since the outbreak of the Korean War, and the negotiations for an armistice offered the opportunity for a new Secretary-General to turn the page. The British delegation dragged out the selection process as they campaigned for Lester Pearson of Canada, but he was vetoed by the Soviet Union.

zh.s: 1953年，特吕格韦·赖伊宣布有意辞职后，联合国开始遴选新任秘书长。朝鲜战争爆发后，赖伊一直与苏联关系紧张；朝鲜停战谈判为新任秘书长开启新局面提供了机会。英国代表团支持加拿大的莱斯特·皮尔逊，拖延了遴选进程，但皮尔逊遭到苏联否决。

en.t: The Battle of Điện Biên Phủ begins with an artillery barrage by Viet Minh forces under Võ Nguyên Giáp; Viet Minh victory led to the end of the First Indochina War and French withdrawal from Vietnam
en.s: The Battle of Điện Biên Phủ was a defeat of the French Union forces by the Viet Minh forces in the First Indochina War. It took place between 13 March and 7 May 1954. The French began an operation to insert, and support, their soldiers at Điện Biên Phủ, deep in the autonomous Tai Federation in northwest Tonkin.

zh.s: 奠边府战役于1954年3月13日至5月7日进行，是第一次印度支那战争期间法兰西联盟军队被越盟击败的一场战役。法军在东京西北部、泰族自治区腹地的奠边府展开行动，试图将部队空运至当地并为其提供支援。

zh.s: 1956年新罕布什尔州共和党总统初选于3月13日举行，是共和党为该年美国总统选举挑选候选人的州级提名竞选之一。现任总统德怀特·艾森豪威尔没有对手，获胜优势创下该州1952年开始直接投票选择总统候选人以来的最高纪录。

en.t: Cuban student revolutionaries storm the presidential palace in Havana in a failed attempt on the life of President Fulgencio Batista
en.s: The Museum of the Revolution (Spanish: Museo de la Revolución) is located in the Old Havana section of Havana, Cuba, in what was the presidential palace of all Cuban presidents from Mario García Menocal to Fulgencio Batista. The building became the Museum of the Revolution during the years following the Cuban Revolution. The palace building was attacked by the Directorio Revolucionario 13 de Marzo in 1957.

zh.t: 古巴学生革命者袭击哈瓦那总统府，企图刺杀总统富尔亨西奥·巴蒂斯塔但未遂
zh.s: 革命博物馆（西班牙语：Museo de la Revolución）位于古巴哈瓦那老城，设在原总统府内。从马里奥·加西亚·梅诺卡尔到富尔亨西奥·巴蒂斯塔时期，这里一直是古巴总统府。古巴革命后数年，建筑改为革命博物馆。1957年3月，3月13日革命指导委员会袭击了总统府。

en.t: Apollo 9 returns safely to Earth after testing the Lunar Module
en.s: Apollo 9 (March 3–13, 1969) was the third human spaceflight in NASA's Apollo program, which successfully tested systems and procedures critical to landing on the Moon. The three-man crew consisted of Commander James McDivitt, Command Module Pilot David Scott, and Lunar Module Pilot Rusty Schweickart.

zh.t: 阿波罗9号安全返回地球
zh.s: 阿波罗9号任务于1969年3月3日至13日进行，是NASA阿波罗计划的第三次载人航天飞行，成功测试了登月所需的重要系统和流程。三名机组人员分别是指令长詹姆斯·麦克迪维特、指令舱驾驶员戴维·斯科特和登月舱驾驶员拉斯蒂·施威卡特。

en.s: Sierra Pacific Airlines Flight 802 was a charter flight from Bishop, California to Burbank, California that crashed into the White Mountains on the evening of March 13, 1974. The aircraft, carrying a movie production crew, crashed for undetermined reasons, killing all 36 occupants on board. To this day, the crash remains one of only three aviation accidents to be unsolved by the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), and it stands as the fourth-deadliest crash of a Convair CV-440 to date.

zh.t: 塞拉太平洋航空802号航班空难
zh.s: 塞拉太平洋航空802号航班是一趟从加利福尼亚州毕晓普飞往伯班克的包机，于1974年3月13日晚撞上怀特山脉。机上载有一支电影制作团队，全部36人遇难，事故原因未能确定。原文记载，这是美国国家运输安全委员会仅有的三起未能查明原因的航空事故之一，也是康维尔CV-440机型死亡人数第四多的空难。

en.t: The New Jewel Movement, headed by Maurice Bishop, ousts the Prime Minister of Grenada, Eric Gairy, in a coup d'état
en.s: The New Joint Endeavor for Welfare, Education, and Liberation, or New JEWEL Movement (NJM), was a Marxist–Leninist vanguard party in the Caribbean island nation of Grenada that was led by Maurice Bishop. Established in 1973, the NJM issued its manifesto prior to Grenada being granted independence from the United Kingdom in 1974. The NJM took control of Grenada with a bloodless coup in 1979 and ruled by decree as the People's Revolutionary Government until 1983.

zh.t: 新宝石运动发动政变，推翻格林纳达总理埃里克·盖里
zh.s: 新联合事业、福利、教育与解放运动，简称新宝石运动（NJM），是加勒比岛国格林纳达的马克思列宁主义先锋党，由莫里斯·毕晓普领导。该组织成立于1973年，并在格林纳达于1974年脱离英国独立前发布了宣言。1979年，新宝石运动通过一场不流血政变控制格林纳达，随后以法令治理国家，建立人民革命政府，直至1983年。

en.t: The Seikan Tunnel, the longest tunnel in the world with an undersea segment, opens between Aomori and Hakodate, Japan
en.s: The Seikan Tunnel (Japanese: 青函トンネル, Seikan Tonneru or 青函隧道, Seikan Zuidō) is a 53.85-kilometre (33.5-mile) dual-gauge railway tunnel in Japan, with a 23.3-kilometre (14.5-mile) segment running beneath the seabed of the Tsugaru Strait, which separates Aomori Prefecture on Honshu, Japan's main island, from the northern island of Hokkaido. The tunnel's track level lies approximately 100 metres (330 ft) below the seabed and 240 metres (790 ft) below sea level.

en.s: STS-29 was the 28th NASA Space Shuttle mission, during which Space Shuttle Discovery inserted a Tracking and Data Relay Satellite (TDRS) into Earth orbit. It was the third shuttle mission following the Challenger disaster in 1986, and launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida, on March 13, 1989. STS-29R was the eighth flight of Discovery and the 28th Space Shuttle mission overall; its planned predecessor, STS-28, was delayed until August 1989.

zh.s: STS-29是NASA第28次航天飞机任务。任务中，“发现号”航天飞机将一颗跟踪与数据中继卫星送入地球轨道。这是1986年“挑战者号”事故后第三次航天飞机任务，于1989年3月13日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射。STS-29R是“发现号”第八次飞行，也是航天飞机计划的第28次任务；原计划先执行的STS-28推迟至1989年8月。

en.s: The Dunblane massacre was a school shooting that took place at Dunblane Primary School in Dunblane, near Stirling, Scotland, on 13 March 1996, when 43-year-old Thomas Hamilton killed 16 pupils and one teacher and injured 15 others before killing himself. It remains the deadliest mass shooting in British history. Following the killings, public debate centred on gun control laws, including public petitions for a ban on private ownership of handguns and an official inquiry, which produced the 1996 Cullen Report.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Benin on 13 March 2011 after being postponed twice from 27 February and 6 March 2011. en.s: The Sierre coach crash occurred on 13 March 2012 near Sierre, Switzerland, when a coach carrying school teachers and pupils crashed into a wall in the Sierre Tunnel. Of the 52 people on board, 28 were killed in the crash, including both drivers, all four teachers, and 22 of the 46 children. The other 24 pupils, all aged between 10 and 12, were injured, including three who were hospitalised with severe brain and chest injuries. The coach was one of three operated by the Aarschot-based Top Tours company and was transporting mostly Belgian school teachers and students from a skiing holiday in Val d'Anniviers back to their two schools in Belgium.

zh.s: 2012年3月13日，一辆载着教师和学生的客车在瑞士锡耶尔附近的隧道内撞墙。车上52人中有28人死亡，包括两名司机、全部4名教师，以及46名儿童中的22人。其余24名学生均受伤，年龄在10至12岁之间，其中3人因脑部和胸部重伤住院。该车是总部位于阿尔斯霍特的Top Tours公司运营的三辆客车之一，正把在阿尼维耶谷滑雪度假的师生送回比利时的两所学校，乘客大多来自比利时。

en.s: The Saxony-Anhalt state election was held on 13 March 2016 in Saxony-Anhalt for the 7th legislative period of the Landtag of Saxony-Anhalt. The incumbent Minister-President was Reiner Haseloff of the CDU, governing in a grand coalition with the SPD. After the elections, a governing coalition consisting of the CDU, the SPD and the Greens was formed, and Haseloff was re-elected as minister president of Saxony-Anhalt on 25 April 2016. The coalition has been nicknamed the "Kenya coalition" because the participating parties' colors are black, red, and green, the colors of the flag of Kenya.

The focal point of the show was the Eponymous Rebelión de los Juniors tournament, an eight-man elimination match where all wrestlers were either second or third-generatoon wrestlers. en.s: The Baden-Württemberg state election 2016 was held on 13 March 2016 to elect members to Baden-Württemberg's State diet, the Landtag of Baden-Württemberg in Stuttgart. It was the 15th state election since the foundation of Baden-Württemberg in 1952. Going into the election, Winfried Kretschmann of Alliance '90/The Greens led a coalition government of his party with the Social Democrats. After the election, Kretschman was confirmed in May 2016 leading a coalition with the CDU, the first time the Greens have led such a coalition in Germany. Like in all German states, elections in Baden-Württemberg follow the mixed member proportional representation.
